desc: Derive the binomial-expansion formula for adding all subarrays ending at the current position.
Specify prefix-power maintenance and modular arithmetic details, including the initial prefix \(P_0=0\).

Verify the recurrence on edge cases such as \(N=1\), zero elements, and \(K=1\), and check complexity against the constraints.
